source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: This unit can be Empowered for one [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) when picked for combat in the [Fight Phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). For the rest of that phase, pick one change for the melee weapons of its models other than **CHARACTER** models. Set Attacks to 3, or set Attacks to 4 and give those weapons **[[HAZARDOUS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/hazardous)**.
